phenomena.claim: Electromagnetic actions propagate at finite speed equal to the speed of light -- the classic experimental confirmation of Maxwell's unification
phenomena.source: Hertz, 'Ueber die Ausbreitungsgeschwindigkeit der electrodynamischen Wirkungen', Ann. Phys. 270, 551-569 (1888), doi:10.1002/andp.18882700708 -- record verified via Wiley Online Library listing 2026-09-23; produced/detected propagating electric waves and established finite propagation at light speed
phenomena.caveat: historical primary; the modern precision statement is carried by the SI definition of c (see constants)

phenomena.claim: Stable localized solutions of classical nonlinear field equations (solitons) are observed in real media: optical-fiber solitons propagate as predicted by the nonlinear Schrodinger description
phenomena.source: Mollenauer, Stolen & Gordon, Phys. Rev. Lett. 45, 1095-1098 (1980) ('Experimental Observation of Picosecond Pulse Narrowing and Solitons in Optical Fibers') -- abstract-verified via APS/ADS listing 2026-09-23; historical first report of a solitary water wave: Russell's 1844 'Report on Waves' (not fetched)
phenomena.caveat: the stability is a property of the classical nonlinear wave equation; no quantization enters the description -- relevant to cluster R3

formalism.claim: Maxwell's field equations unify electricity, magnetism, and optics: they admit transverse wave solutions propagating at c = 1/sqrt(eps0*mu0), numerically matching the measured speed of light, from which Maxwell deduced that light is an electromagnetic wave
formalism.source: Maxwell, 'A Dynamical Theory of the Electromagnetic Field', Phil. Trans. R. Soc. Lond. 155, 459-512 (1865), doi:10.1098/rstl.1865.0008 -- record verified via Royal Society / JSTOR / Internet Archive listings 2026-09-23
formalism.caveat: Lorentz invariance was subsequently read off these field equations before mechanics conformed (Lorentz/Poincare/Einstein 1905) -- the field theory drove the spacetime symmetry, not the reverse

formalism.claim: Classical field dynamics is standardly generated by stationary action of a local Lagrangian density (Hamilton's principle for fields); the Euler-Lagrange equations reproduce the field equations
formalism.source: textbook-standard (e.g. Landau & Lifshitz, Classical Theory of Fields; Goldstein, Classical Mechanics)
formalism.caveat: not every useful classical system is variational without extension (dissipative continuum equations such as Navier-Stokes lack a standard local action principle)

formalism.claim: The classical relativistic field equations (wave, Maxwell, Einstein evolution systems) admit (symmetric-)hyperbolic formulations with well-posed Cauchy problems: existence, uniqueness, continuous dependence on initial data, and finite propagation speed / domain-of-dependence structure
formalism.source: Sarbach & Tiglio, 'Continuum and Discrete Initial-Boundary-Value Problems and Einstein's Field Equations', Living Rev. Relativity 15, 9 (2012), arXiv:1203.6443 -- abstract-verified 2026-09-23
formalism.caveat: this hyperbolicity/causal-cone structure is the classical locality structure: causal cones come from the PDE type alone, with no quantum input

formalism.claim: Classical Maxwell theory already carries gauge redundancy: the potential A_mu is determined only up to A_mu -> A_mu + partial_mu(chi), the fields E and B are invariant, and only gauge-invariant quantities are physical -- the structure predates and is independent of quantization
formalism.source: textbook-standard (e.g. Jackson, Classical Electrodynamics); the quantum/SM reading of gauge redundancy is carried by the sibling record -- see gauge_theory/formalism
formalism.caveat: cross-reference, not duplication: representational status and 'forced by SM consistency' grading live in gauge_theory

primitives.claim: Field configurations on spacetime (with conjugate momenta on a Cauchy surface) are the primitives of the framework; in Maxwell theory charged particles enter as external sources, and the point-charge idealization is singular (divergent self-energy)
primitives.source: textbook-standard; the self-energy pathology is documented in the known_disconnects entry (Dirac 1938)

primitives.claim: Locality is a primitive modeling commitment of classical field theory: dynamics is specified by local partial differential equations in the fields, not derived from anything deeper within the framework
primitives.source: textbook-standard; the corpus-level statement of what locality buys (causal cones) is the hyperbolicity entry in formalism
primitives.caveat: recorded as a primitive of this framework, not as a claim that nature is fundamentally local

derived_objects.claim: Conserved currents and the energy-momentum tensor are derived objects: spacetime translation symmetry yields the canonical stress tensor (improvable to the symmetric Belinfante form) via Noether's first theorem
derived_objects.source: Noether 1918 (see symmetries for the verified primary); Belinfante improvement textbook-standard
derived_objects.caveat: the canonical tensor is non-unique off-shell; improvement terms change nothing conserved

derived_objects.claim: KdV solitons are exactly derivable: the inverse-scattering method solves the initial-value problem and predicts exactly the solitons emerging from arbitrary initial conditions, with N-soliton interactions in closed form
derived_objects.source: Gardner, Greene, Kruskal & Miura, Phys. Rev. Lett. 19, 1095 (1967) ('Method for Solving the Korteweg-deVries Equation'), doi:10.1103/PhysRevLett.19.1095 -- abstract-verified 2026-09-23; the term 'soliton' and the elastic-collision phenomenology: Zabusky & Kruskal, Phys. Rev. Lett. 15, 240 (1965) -- title/venue verified via APS listing 2026-09-23 (no abstract displayed)
derived_objects.caveat: integrable 1+1-dimensional case; higher-dimensional soliton existence is structure-dependent (see known_disconnects, Derrick)

derived_objects.claim: Nonlinear (orbital) stability of the KdV solitary wave is proven within classical PDE theory, from the conservation laws and variational structure alone
derived_objects.source: Benjamin, 'The stability of solitary waves', Proc. R. Soc. Lond. A 328, 153-183 (1972), doi:10.1098/rspa.1972.0074 -- record verified via ADS listing 2026-09-23
derived_objects.caveat: existence proof that localized-solution stability does not require quanta -- relevant to cluster R3; stability notion is orbital (modulo symmetry), not asymptotic

empirical_inputs.claim: Sources and material response enter as inputs at the continuum level: charge/current distributions, permittivity/permeability of media, equations of state, elastic moduli, and transport coefficients are supplied, not derived within the field theory itself
empirical_inputs.caveat: for fluids these inputs are computable in principle from the microscopic level -- the one demonstrated reduction chain, with its precise scope recorded under limits

constants.claim: c = 299 792 458 m/s, exact: fixed by the 1983 SI redefinition of the metre
constants.source: CODATA recommended values, NIST CUU (physics.nist.gov/cgi-bin/cuu/Value?c) -- page fetched 2026-09-23; standard uncertainty stated '(exact)'
constants.caveat: exact by definition since 1983; the empirical content moved into realizations of the metre, so 'observed' refers to the pre-1983 measurement chain the definition froze

symmetries.claim: Noether's first theorem: every continuous symmetry of the action (finite-dimensional Lie group of variational symmetries) yields a conservation law of the field equations
symmetries.source: Noether, 'Invariante Variationsprobleme', Nachr. Ges. Wiss. Goettingen, Math.-Phys. Kl. 1918, 235-257; English translation by M. A. Tavel reproduced as arXiv:physics/0503066 -- abstract-verified 2026-09-23 (combination of variational calculus with Lie group theory; theorems of Section 1)
symmetries.caveat: conservation holds on-shell; the symmetry-to-law map is for variational symmetries, and converse statements carry qualifications

symmetries.claim: Noether's second theorem: when the symmetry group is infinite-dimensional (parametrized by arbitrary functions -- gauge symmetry), the Euler-Lagrange equations are underdetermined and satisfy differential identities (gauge identities) rather than yielding additional independent conservation laws; charge conservation in electrodynamics and the contracted Bianchi identities in GR are the standard instances
symmetries.source: Noether 1918, same verified translation (the 'special infinite groups' of the paper's second theorem, engaging Klein's second note); historical/mathematical account: Kosmann-Schwarzbach, The Noether Theorems: Invariance and Conservation Laws in the Twentieth Century (Springer 2011) -- record verified via Springer/AMS-review listings 2026-09-23
symmetries.caveat: the second theorem's output is identity-type (constraints among equations), a structurally different object from first-theorem conserved charges; the GR instance is recorded in general_relativity_gravity/symmetries (diffeomorphism Ward identity)

limits.claim: Geometric optics (rays, eikonal equation) is recovered from wave optics in the short-wavelength limit
limits.source: textbook-standard (Born & Wolf, Principles of Optics, eikonal expansion)
limits.caveat: edge type LIMIT_RELATION; fails near caustics and where diffraction matters

limits.claim: Newtonian gravity is recovered from GR in the weak-field slow-motion limit -- carried by the sibling record
limits.source: cross-reference: see general_relativity_gravity/limits (weak-field slow-motion entry); not restated here

limits.claim: Fluid mechanics is the demonstrated micro-to-macro reduction on record: Newtonian hard-sphere dynamics yields the Boltzmann equation rigorously in the Boltzmann-Grad limit for short times (Lanford-type theorem), and the Boltzmann equation yields incompressible Navier-Stokes(-Fourier) rigorously in scaled hydrodynamic limits
limits.source: Gallagher, Saint-Raymond & Texier, 'From Newton to Boltzmann: hard spheres and short-range potentials', arXiv:1208.5753 -- abstract-verified 2026-09-23 (rigorous derivation, N*eps^(d-1) = 1 scaling, valid for a fraction of the mean first-collision time, building on Lanford); Golse & Saint-Raymond, 'The Navier-Stokes limit of the Boltzmann equation for bounded collision kernels', Invent. Math. 155, 81-161 (2004), doi:10.1007/s00222-003-0316-5 -- record verified via Springer listing 2026-09-23 (DiPerna-Lions renormalized solutions converge to Leray solutions)
limits.caveat: what 'derived' means here is bounded: theorem-grade only in scaled limits (Boltzmann-Grad; short times for the Newton step; bounded collision kernels and weak-solution framework for the Navier-Stokes step); outside these regimes the reduction is standard-physics Chapman-Enskog, not theorem-grade -- still the strongest reduction chain in the corpus

known_connections.claim: Lagrangian and Hamiltonian formulations are equivalent for regular (non-degenerate) Lagrangians via the Legendre transform; degenerate/gauge Lagrangians pass through constrained Hamiltonian (Dirac) analysis; the symplectic-geometric formulation is the coordinate-free carrier of the same structure
known_connections.source: Dirac, 'Generalized Hamiltonian Dynamics', Can. J. Math. 2, 129-148 (1950) -- record verified via Cambridge Core listing 2026-09-23; regular-case equivalence textbook-standard; for the Reverse-Physics grounding of Hamiltonian structure (equivalence to determinism plus reversibility) see statistical_mechanics_thermodynamics/known_connections -- cross-reference, not restated
known_connections.caveat: equivalence claims are formulation-level, per system class (regular vs constrained)

known_connections.claim: Classical Maxwell gauge redundancy is the classical face of the SM U(1) structure, and the second-theorem gauge identities tie this record to the gauge and gravity records
known_connections.source: cross-references: gauge_theory/formalism (gauge redundancy representational; Elitzur), general_relativity_gravity/symmetries (diffeomorphism Ward identity / covariant conservation)
known_connections.caveat: edge inventory only; typing to the seven-class scheme is Stage-3 work

known_disconnects.claim: For a wide class of nonlinear scalar wave equations in three space dimensions there exist NO stable time-independent finite-energy solutions (Derrick's scaling theorem): soliton existence is structure-dependent, evaded by topological terms, gauge fields, higher-derivative (Skyrme) terms, or time dependence (Q-balls)
known_disconnects.source: Derrick, 'Comments on Nonlinear Wave Equations as Models for Elementary Particles', J. Math. Phys. 5, 1252-1254 (1964), doi:10.1063/1.1704233 -- abstract-verified via AIP/ADS listings 2026-09-23
known_disconnects.caveat: a no-go for a specific class, not for classical localized solutions generally (see derived_objects and phenomena)

known_disconnects.claim: Classical electrodynamics of point charges is not internally complete: the point-charge self-energy diverges, and the Lorentz-Dirac radiation-reaction equation admits runaway and pre-accelerating solutions; standard practice is effective order-reduction (Landau-Lifshitz form)
known_disconnects.source: Dirac, 'Classical theory of radiating electrons', Proc. R. Soc. Lond. A 167, 148-169 (1938), doi:10.1098/rspa.1938.0124 -- record verified via Royal Society/ADS listings 2026-09-23
known_disconnects.caveat: pathology of the point-particle idealization coupled to the field, not of the free field dynamics

open_problems.claim: Global existence and smoothness of 3D Navier-Stokes solutions is unresolved (Clay Millennium Prize problem, still active)
open_problems.source: Clay Mathematics Institute Millennium problem page (claymath.org, official statement by Fefferman) -- page fetched 2026-09-23, problem listed as active/unsolved

open_problems.claim: No derivation of fully developed turbulence statistics from the Navier-Stokes equations exists; the Kolmogorov 1941 scaling framework remains phenomenological, with measured intermittency corrections underived
open_problems.source: converter: fetch of a standard review at abstract/preface level, e.g. Frisch, Turbulence: The Legacy of A. N. Kolmogorov (CUP 1995), or a modern review of intermittency and anomalous scaling
open_problems.caveat: widely held community assessment; recorded as TO-VERIFY until a checked source is attached

observables.claim: Classical field observables are measured directly at macroscopic scale: E and B via forces on test charges, energy flux (Poynting), wave amplitude/phase/polarization, and fluid velocity/pressure/stress fields; the gauge potential itself is not a classical observable
observables.source: textbook-standard; the quantum-level gauge-invariant content (holonomies/Wilson loops, Aharonov-Bohm) is carried by gauge_theory/observables -- cross-reference
observables.caveat: the Aharonov-Bohm effect is a quantum phenomenon and does not upgrade A_mu to a classical observable

alternative_formulations.claim: Maxwell theory admits coexisting standard formulations: potential-based action, first-order field-strength form, differential-forms form (dF = 0, d*F = *J), and gauge-invariant holonomy coordinates
alternative_formulations.source: textbook-standard; fiber-bundle/holonomy formulation graded in gauge_theory/alternative_formulations -- cross-reference

alternative_formulations.claim: Classical mechanics itself admits equivalent Newtonian, Lagrangian, Hamiltonian, and Hamilton-Jacobi formulations for regular systems; the Reverse-Physics program rederives such structure from identified physical assumptions
alternative_formulations.source: textbook-standard; for the Reverse-Physics formulation and its audited equivalences see statistical_mechanics_thermodynamics/alternative_formulations and known_connections -- cross-reference, not restated
alternative_formulations.caveat: equivalence is per system class; degenerate cases follow the Dirac route (see known_connections)

domain_of_validity.claim: Classical electrodynamics is valid at macroscopic field strengths and large photon occupation; it fails where photon discreteness matters (see quantum_mechanics/phenomena) and its exact linearity in vacuum fails at loop level: light-by-light scattering gamma gamma -> gamma gamma has been directly seen in Pb+Pb ultraperipheral collisions
domain_of_validity.source: ATLAS Collaboration, 'Evidence for light-by-light scattering in heavy-ion collisions with the ATLAS detector at the LHC', Nature Physics 13, 852-858 (2017), arXiv:1702.01625 -- abstract-verified 2026-09-23 (13 candidate events over 2.6 +/- 0.7 expected background; sigma = 70 +/- 24 (stat) +/- 17 (syst) nb)
domain_of_validity.caveat: cited measurement is evidence-level; the boundary statement (vacuum nonlinearity is a QED effect absent from classical Maxwell theory) is what this entry records

domain_of_validity.claim: Continuum descriptions (fluids, elasticity) are valid under scale separation (Knudsen number << 1); they fail in rarefied, microscale, or shock-thickness regimes where kinetic or molecular descriptions take over
domain_of_validity.source: textbook-standard (kinetic theory of gases / rarefied gas dynamics)
domain_of_validity.caveat: the demonstrated hand-off to the microscopic level is the limits entry (Newton -> Boltzmann -> Navier-Stokes)

notes: TRANCHE-2 record, built 2026-09-23. Verification method: every VERIFIED entry carrying an external citation was checked the same day at abstract/record level (arXiv abstracts, NIST/Clay pages fetched; APS/ADS/Wiley/Royal Society/Springer/Cambridge listings where publisher abstract pages returned 403), fetch dates recorded per entry; 'textbook-standard' sourcing follows the tranche-1 convention for uncontested framework content and names no unchecked bibliographic record. One TO-VERIFY entry (turbulence phenomenology) names its converter. No PROGRAM-RESULT entries: this domain carries no in-house program claims. Cross-reference policy honored: gauge redundancy grading -> gauge_theory; Newtonian limit -> general_relativity_gravity; Reverse-Physics equivalences and the kinetic-theory home -> statistical_mechanics_thermodynamics; photon discreteness -> quantum_mechanics. Requirement relativity: nothing here asserts a structure is required (Stage 4). Soliton entries (phenomena, derived_objects) record classical existence and proven stability without quanta -- flagged as relevant to cluster R3.
